build.macOSReleaseCI: .github/workflows/ci.yml macos-release (Ship hosted runner and Xcode guard; optimized universal native app build; required swift check joins release compilation, product tests and shared-view reference images)

test.pythonWorkers: Config/ContextPanelTestLanes.json workersByFile (pytest-xdist via uv for independent unittest fixtures; --serial uses standard unittest; docs/test-lanes.md)
test.changeDetectorWarnings: .github/workflows/ci.yml swift-tests (warning-only shared scanner checked out from cbusillo/codex-skills; annotates all tracked tests on every run; https://github.com/cbusillo/codex-skills/blob/main/skills/references/test-quality.md)

validate.googleAntigravityUsage: swift test --filter googleAntigravity (direct /usage parser, privacy, safe storage, hook command and immediate publication; docs/provider-usage-access.md#google-antigravity-connector)
validate.releaseApprovalPolicy: uv run scripts/check-release-approvals.py (classified-graph structural dry-run: zero human approvals; automatic secretless Ship and standalone intent jobs; same-commit local channels inherit repository secrets; one release secret environment; live no-click environment-metadata check; owner reviewer-removal hand step and RELEASE_APPROVALS_CONFIGURED=true required); unclassified environment selectors must prove disjointness from reserved release names, with literal and fixed-namespace lookup routes; unclassified reusable calls remain accepted and report incomplete coverage (docs/release.md)
validate.ciChangeScope: uv run --no-project python scripts/ci-change-scope.py --event <event> --ref <ref> [--pr-base <sha>] [--before <sha>] [--pr-number <n>] (ci.yml scope job; a pull request that changes a reference image fails until its body has the '## Reference images' statement; compares a pull request with its base, a main push with the previous tip, a merge-train candidate with main; product=false skips universal macOS Release compilation and companion builds; hermetic Swift and Python tests always run; references=false skips both reference image jobs; simulator_references=false (also every pull request and merge-train candidate, except a pull request that changes a Tests/SharedViewReferences/*.png reference image) skips shared-view-simulator-references; a failure on main opens or updates the plan issue through scripts/ci-reference-failure-issue.py (tests: uv run --no-project python -m unittest Tests.ScriptsTests.test_ci_reference_failure_issue); manual runs, unknown bases and unknown paths run everything; app_store_mac_capture adds the isolated native capture job without skipping CI gates; CodeQL always runs)
validate.companionUploadFixtureTools: CONTEXT_PANEL_UPLOAD_FIXTURE_TOOLS_DIR=<dir> scripts/upload-app-store-connect-companion-app.sh --export-only <other arguments> (test-only seam; docs/release.md owns fixture boundaries)
validate.loadedRefreshAgentFixtureTests: uv run --no-project python -m unittest -k runtime_baseline_loaded_agent Tests.ScriptsTests.test_release_workflows (inert process, launchd and mapped-executable fixtures; no runtime validation or app/agent mutation)
validate.macOSUploadFixtureTests: uv run --no-project python -m unittest Tests.ScriptsTests.test_macos_upload_script (export-only fixture seam and fake profiles; docs/release.md owns fixture boundaries)
validate.cloudKitSchemaGate: scripts/cloudkit-schema-gate.py check (each publication workflow step; checks Production only when CloudKit/ changed since the newest reachable release tag whose GitHub Release github-actions[bot] published; docs/release.md#cloudkit-production-schema-gate)
validate.githubReleasePublication: scripts/publish-github-release.py --validate-only <release arguments> (non-mutating package eligibility check; publication policy and validation-artifact route: docs/release.md#ci-signing-and-notarization-secrets)
validate.validationGalleryIsolation: scripts/check-validation-gallery-isolation.sh --products-root <derived-data>/Build/Products (run by validate-companion-builds.sh after every build or archive)
validate.companionCacheRetention: scripts/context-panel-companion-cache.sh prune --root <absolute-.build-or-derived-data/companion-build-validation-root> [--older-than-days N] [--apply] (default: preview unsigned quarantine entries older than seven days; apply is explicit)
validate.sharedViewReferenceImages: .github/workflows/ci.yml shared-view-references and shared-view-simulator-references (macos-26 with the Xcode, runtimes and devices pinned in Config/ContextPanelSharedViewSimulators.json; draw every shared-view cell in its host frame and compare it with Tests/SharedViewReferences; re-record route: docs/validation-authority.md#reference-images)
validate.sharedViewReferenceTests: uv run --no-project python -m unittest Tests/ScriptsTests/test_shared_view_references.py && swift test --filter SharedViewRendererToolTests
validate.appStoreSubmissionGate: scripts/submit-app-store-review.py (live submission refuses unless the Ship record's source commit has a passing shared-view-simulator-references job and the build has been on TestFlight 24 hours with no crash report for it, unless skip_soak_reason; dry run reports only; scripts/app_store_submission_gate.py; tests: uv run --no-project python -m unittest Tests/ScriptsTests/test_app_store_submission_gate.py Tests/ScriptsTests/test_submit_app_store_review.py; docs/release.md#app-store-review-submission)
validate.validationGalleryTests: swift test --filter 'ValidationGallery|ValidationFixtures|validationGallery|validationFixture' && uv run --no-project python -m unittest Tests/ScriptsTests/test_validation_gallery_target_graph.py
validate.runtimeBaselineFixtureTests: uv run --no-project --with pyyaml python -m unittest -k runtime_baseline Tests.ScriptsTests.test_release_workflows (inert bundle, process and launchd fixtures; no installed-app validation)

importantWorkflows: App Store Connect Companion Build Upload

updateWhen: default-branch rulesets or required status checks change
catalog metadata schema or overall direction changes
